profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Symetra
profile.summary: 7+ Years Software Engineering – Skilled in understanding requirements, easily communicates with all levels of staff, ability to work independently as well as in a team environment, seeks out feedback on designs, and understands the importance of working closely with QA.  Proficient in SDLC including experience with Waterfall and Agile approaches.  Adept at gathering and prioritizing requirements, designing specifications, overcoming obstacles, managing risks, and delivering timely and high quality applications.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Part of an integrations team the creates new solutions for other teams to help automate their internal processes and/or create integrations with external partners.  Activities included writing code, designing solutions,  mentoring junior developers, and gathering requirements. Solutions are built in AWS and employ a complete CI/CD pipeline.
positions.insights: Skills: AWS Lambda · AWS Fargate · Python (Programming Language) · API Gateways · AWS Step Functions

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Part of a group working on adding features to the Expedia Agent Web Application - for managing flights
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · jQuery · jasmine · HTML · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work in an Agile environment, with daily scrum, using VersionOne as the primary Agile support tool.  Member of a sprint team whose main focus is building strategic investing products and features. Work very close with business to build out stories to ensure they are accurate, understandable by development, prioritized and reasonably sized.  Software development efforts are primarily back office focused creating APIs and database objects.  Recent technical CI/CD project is directing new learnings of Linux, Jenkins, and AWS (EC2, CloudFormation).
Technical Skills: C# (WebApi, RestSharp), Java (HttpClient 4.5), MS SQL, SSRS, Sybase, SpringBatch, gradle, javascript, VS 2005-2015, Eclipse, Git/GitHub, Swagger, XUnit, Moq, JUnit, SQL Mgmt Studio, AquaData Studio, Nuget, splunk, Accurev, AntHill Pro, Nexus, Artifactory

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked in Agile environment, with daily scrum, using VersionOne as the primary tool supporting the Agile environment. Designed and implemented communication programs for exchanging tax return information with the IRS modernized systems and successfully deployed alpha version on Amazon EC2. Built tool to automate testing tax return calculations and perform result comparisons with reporting on calculation differences. 
Start up company thus responsibilities were broad and included interfacing with customers, coordinating with partners, gathering requirements, and writing user stories. Also, set up TFS, SharePoint, and SQL Reporting Services.
Technical Skills: C# (WSE 2.0, WCF, WPF+XAML), XML, MS SQL 2008/T-SQL, Soap, NHibernate, VSTS 2008/2010, TFS

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
Managed a team of ten and oversaw the development and implementation of all projects associated to the IntelliTax 24X7 data center. Delivered pragmatic solutions meeting business process initiatives, product launches and other company strategies and objectives. Listened to the needs of stakeholders and transformed this information into practical requirements.  Worked with QA, IT, project managers, and product managers to prioritize requirements, establish metrics for measuring project success, and to coordinate schedules.  Identified project risks and determined strategies to address them.
Technical Skills: MS Project, SQL, Seapine defect tracking and source control, Feature Plan

positions.title: Business Analyst / Manager
positions.description:
Part of team assigned to roll out new CRM application (Axapta). Gathered and determined requirements while working with outside implementation team to design new systems: Financial, Call Ticket, Contact Management, Order Entry, Shipping, and Reporting.
Worked with senior management on data mining and reporting needs.
Managed AR, IT, and Facilities departments (approx. nine FTE).
Technical Skills: MS Project, MS Power Point, Access, Crystal Reports, SQL

positions.title: Decision Support / Manager
positions.description:
Focus was on improving the operation of a growing company by streamlining processes. Designed and implemented many internal applications including: company wide department expense and revenue projection budgeting system, call ticketing, order entry, shipping, and reporting tools for Executives and Sales.
Other responsibilities included acting as liaison with Banking Partner technical and business staff and managing a small team responsible for customer setup.
Technical Skills: C, VB, Access, VBA, SQL, Crystal Reports

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Designed, implemented, and tested all bank product applications in the client tax software and back end 24X7 data center. Interpreted and implemented trading partner specifications for the exchange of tax information.  Trading partners included the IRS, State taxing authorities, and Banks.
Technical Skills: C, Btrieve
